_about: Ours, not a design copy. Day 1 in Fernbrook (crates, Two Lights, Fen at dusk), Fen's go-home talk, Mom's ask, Lizzy's class, the three Trial Hall holders, the contested signs. objPatch edits existing objects by id after every overlay (game.js applyObjPatch); sceneTails and lineSwaps adjust built scenes without touching the design JSON. Save stays pixelpets.save.v2: every flag is a new story.* key, read only, nothing written at load.

lines.fenCrew: Three holders wait on the path first, {name}. Win all three, then come up to me.

looks._note: PLACEHOLDER looks (Story/Design). The cadet keeps the Keeper set (green coat, gold accent; rule 11). The other two wear no uniform.

lines.intro: Cadet's honour: nobody reaches Master Fen without a proper match. Ready?
lines.win: Well rooted, {player}. The Keepers could use hands like yours.
lines.lose: Rest up and try again. The Hall isn't going anywhere.

lines.intro: Old Halls, old rules. My Walklings glow brighter under the new lamps. Watch!
lines.win: Huh. Bright isn't everything, I guess.
lines.lose: See? A little shine goes a long way.

lines.intro: No sides for me. I just pick apples and win matches. Mostly the apples.
lines.win: Go on up. Fen's been waiting for a holder like you.
lines.lose: Back to the orchard with you. Come again!

crate_a: A Pomlet crate. What do you do?
Thunk. The crate goes up on the cart. Tobin's tally board clicks over: one more.
Something small turns over inside and sighs. You stay until it settles.

crates_fen: Master Fen walks up the row. A Pomlet called Russet rides on her shoulder.
Russet planted half this row herself. Her friends in those crates planted the rest.
Two up on the cart already! You're a natural packer.
More listening than stacking, huh? The tally can wait.
Evening comes to Fernbrook. The sky over the orchard turns plum, then dark.
tl_amos: The Lantern House window is dark. Someone is counting on a ladder.
One wick, drowned. One storm, rude. One Loamlet, hurt. That's three problems, {name}.
I call him Burrsnout. He digs under my beds and plants things. Thorn in his paw tonight.
A Lantern House heals anyone who knocks. Rest is 5 Acorns. Short? Pay what you have.
Wynne's stall has wicks. 8 Acorns. I'd go myself, but I can't leave the cot.
tl_cot: Burrsnout tucks his paw away. In this dark, nobody can see the thorn.
tl_juniper: Hi hi! No light? Take a lantern. Free! It's on already. See?
I know folk think we're all shiny talk. But a hurt Walkling shouldn't wait for a wick.
Juniper skips off toward the Lantern House, lantern swinging.
tl_choice: Juniper's lantern glows on the counter. Keeper Amos looks at it for a long moment.
...She's not wrong. A Lantern House can't be everywhere. That's the true part nobody likes.
Every Walkling in the room turns toward the hill at once. Then back. {pet} too.
They do that sometimes. Always toward the hill. I stopped asking why.
Short on Acorns? Battle a little, sell a little. Acorns come back. Walklings don't.
Slow light. Warm light. It'll still be burning when the lamp folk go home.
Yay! See, Keeper Amos? A bright light is kind too. Have a bright night, little thorn-paw!
{pet} sniffs both lights, then curls up between them, one ear toward each.
Wynne's stall, east end of the square. I'll keep the cot warm.
tl_end: In the light, the thorn shows. {pet} noses it, and it slides right out.
Bed's yours tonight, helper. Fen's waiting in the orchard first. She wants a word.
fen_dusk: The Hall opens in the morning. Show me what you two know first. The crates can wait a day.
You bed down at the Lantern House. {pet} curls up by the window.
fen_home: Morning comes to Fernbrook. Mist sits low over the orchard.
{name}. I watched you with those crates, and with Amos. You and {pet} have real potential.
But word came in the night. Disturbances, out in the Amberwild. Walklings acting strange.
I'm off to see the Keeper authorities about readying holders for it. The Hall stays shut.
Go home for now. While you're there, sit in on Lizzy's class at the Schoolhouse.
Go home for now. Your mom will be glad to see you. I'll send word when the Hall is ready.
Master Fen sets off up the road, Russet riding on her shoulder.
mom_class: One more thing, love. Lizzy's teaching a class at the Schoolhouse. Go and sit in.
She'll tell you how things stand between the Keepers and Glimmerwell. Better from her than from a sign.
lizzy_class: Lizzy's class is in full swing. Pip and Wren sit at their desks. You slip in at the back.
Today's question: who looks after the Amberwild? There are two loud answers.
The Keepers say rest and care come first. Lantern Houses, slow growing, every bed full.
Glimmerwell says brighter and faster. Free lanterns, clean energy, quarterly targets.
My uncle says Glimmerwell lamps make Walklings sleepy.
My mom works for Glimmerwell. They fixed our roof!
See? Both help someone. Towns like Fernbrook sit right between them, and argue it every night.
{name}, Master Fen is back in Fernbrook. Her Trial Hall is open. Go show her what you've learned.

seal1: Go and get some air, {name}. I'll tidy the roots and follow you out.

lineSwaps.text: Thank you, truly. The Hall is open. Come when you're ready, and bring your best.
to: Thank you, truly. Look at them climb. The orchard remembers its friends.

lineSwaps.text: {name}. You stood with us. Before any trial, get to know us.
to: {name}. You stood with us. Now come and get to know us.

lineSwaps.text: We keep by going to look. A Hall ribbon can wait until we know who is missing.
to: We keep by going to look. Your Seal is a start. Now help us find who is missing.

lineSwaps.text: {name}! Welcome, partner. Before the tour, get to know us.
to: {name}! Welcome, partner. First, get to know us.

lineSwaps.text: Go on. Come to the Hall if you must. I'll stand for the orchard there.
to: Go on, then. You won my Seal fairly. After last night, I can't say you're wrong.

lineSwaps.text: Fen walks to the Hall without looking back. The cart rolls off toward the pavilion.
to: Fen walks back to the Hall without looking back. The cart rolls off toward the pavilion.

lineSwaps.text: Great work! Head to the Hall for your partnership review. Have a bright day!
to: Great work! Your partnership file is open. Have a bright day!
